subject.title: [Bug]: OAuth-only xAI: x_search/code_execution never register for CLI-backend (claude-cli) sessions — loopback MCP bridge omits auth profile store

question: Should the fix expose xAI-billed tools on non-xAI CLI parent sessions, or keep those tools gated to active xAI sessions and repair the subagent inheritance/auth propagation path instead?
rationale: The reported missing auth-profile store is real, but exposing `x_search` and `code_execution` on a `claude-cli` parent session intersects the open policy decision about cross-provider xAI-billed tool visibility.

options.title: Preserve provider-billed boundary
options.body: Keep xAI server-side tools visible only when the active session or spawned subagent is xAI-backed, and fix loopback/auth/inheritance so xAI subagents receive OAuth-backed tools.

options.title: Add explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Allow `claude-cli` parent sessions to use xAI-billed tools only through an explicit allowlist or opt-in that makes billing ownership visible.

options.title: Restore credential-only CLI parity
options.body: Thread the auth store into loopback so OAuth credentials make xAI tools visible to any CLI parent session, accepting the cross-provider billing exposure.

recommendation.title: Preserve provider-billed boundary
recommendation.body: Keep xAI server-side tools visible only when the active session or spawned subagent is xAI-backed, and fix loopback/auth/inheritance so xAI subagents receive OAuth-backed tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway loopback behavior and the recently restored claude-cli MCP bridge, where steipete has the clearest current history signal.
